    SmallBusan casino gochujang wingsDouble-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and soy glazeHow to make it1kg chicken wings100g potato starch1 L vegetable oil, for frying2 tbsp gochujang3 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce2 cloves of garlic, crushed1 tbsp sesame seedsToss the wings in the potato starch.Heat the vegetable oil to 160°C and fry the wings, then rest.Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy and garlic until glossy.Fry again at 190°C until crisp.Toss in the sauce and top with sesame.Heart-shaped herb dipRoast beet and dill yoghurt dip with flatbread, fit for a Black PantherHow to make it2 beetroots300g Greek yoghurt1 clove of garlic, crushed1 lemon, juiced1 tbsp dill, chopped4 flatbreadsRoast the beetroot until tender, then peel and grate.Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, lemon juice and dill.Warm the flatbreads and serve with the deep purple dip.Beef suya skewers with onion and tomatoStreet food from hidden WakandaHow to make itNot on tonight's cookThin beef rump strips coated in a peanut, ginger and chilli spice, grilled smoky on skewers and served with sliced tomato, red onion and lime.Blitz 80g roasted peanuts to a fine powder and mix with 2 tsp ground ginger, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder and 1 tsp salt.Slice 800g beef rump into thin strips, toss in oil and then in most of the spice.Thread onto soaked skewers and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side.Scatter with the rest of the spice and serve with sliced tomato, red onion and lime.Puff-puff with chilli honeyStreet sweets. Yield!How to make it1 tin of chopped tomatoes1 red capsicum1 onion1/2 scotch bonnet chilli3 tbsp vegetable oil400g long grain rice700ml chicken stock1 tsp dried thyme800g chicken thighsBlitz the tomatoes, capsicum, onion and chilli.Fry the blended sauce in oil until deep red.Stir in the rice, stock and thyme, cover and bake at 170°C.Grill the chicken thighs until charred and cooked through.Lay the chicken on the rice and serve.M'Baku's sweet potato and peanut stewKumara, chickpeas and spinach in peanut tomato sauce over rice, from the Jabari mountainsHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSweet potato, chickpeas and spinach simmered in a rich peanut, tomato and ginger sauce with chilli, over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander.Soften 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil.Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander and 1 chopped red chilli.Stir in 1 tin crushed tomatoes, 120g smooth peanut butter and 600ml vegetable stock.Add 800g diced sweet potato and 1 drained tin chickpeas and simmer 25 minutes.Stir in 120g spinach and lime juice.Serve over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander.SweetDora Milaje fried plantain with honeyCaramelised ripe plantain with honey, chilli flakes and coconut ice creamHow to make it3 ripe plantains40g butter2 tbsp honey1 pinch of chilli flakes1 tub of coconut ice creamSlice the plantains on the diagonal.Fry in the butter until caramelised.Drizzle with honey and chilli flakes and serve with scoops of ice cream.SipsWakandan hibiscus ginger fizzHibiscus and ginger tea with pineapple and lime, over ice with sparkling waterHow to make it1 L water30g dried hibiscus flowers1 piece of fresh ginger, sliced100g caster sugar200ml pineapple juice2 limes, juiced500ml sparkling water, to top2 cups ice30ml white rum, optional per glassBoil the water with the hibiscus, ginger and sugar, then turn off and steep.Strain and chill.Stir in the pineapple juice and lime juice.Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel.
